flow.name: Reference · Oct2 Calendar filters & Notice — partial
flow.description: Oct2/Oct3 native reference: 42 finite frames and64 configured controls. Calendar All/None/Class/detail/Notice/Exam/Payment, observed date/month cycles, Home DEMO callers, Payment view/history and first DEMO record/Portal remain partial. Added Notification tab: unread workshop → initial/detail with banner → Read more loading/titled blank/menu/Cancel/X, banner expansion/X, read list/reopen and Calendar return. Three actual Present runs preserve footer misselection correction, missing banner/loading mark and same-asset reupload recovery. Early Read more leaves initial timer without redirect. Transient Calendar preview glyph positioning differed; saved stable Calendar crops are equal; cause unisolated. Existing Payment entry lacks native unread badge. Financial/class/private fields synthetic DEMO. Images/static loading mark raster; editable text/vector geometry approximate. All800ms delays are demonstration proxies, not native latency/causality. Blank web page establishes neither service success nor server failure. Search has new native samples but is not integrated here; other notices, arbitrary queries/dates, menus, scrolling, sharing/copy/system browser and untested exits remain incomplete. Saved pixels determine visible state despite lagging URL and black tool previews. Full app/fidelity not_verified.
